defects.what: The masking-tape label on the table, which the script says reads 'Tala', carries Japanese-like glyphs ('なあ い.O. ナ茶せ') across the bottom of the picture.
Large carved Japanese-like glyphs on the marker stone under the hand, and the face at the right is a blonde, blue-eyed girl instead of Indio.
The plaque on the bust's pedestal carries CJK characters, and the shed behind has a Japanese-style roof.
The petition on the desk is several lines of Japanese-like pseudo-text under the word 'Rome'.
Japanese-like glyphs printed in the top-left sky ('く 號田 Ⅲ' under a white shape) and in the bottom-left corner, like a UI caption.
The cave wall is covered with eight lines of Japanese hiragana-like text in the middle of the frame.
The rock Indio touches carries five lines of large Japanese/Chinese-like glyphs.
A big scratched inscription of Japanese-like glyphs across the centre stone.
The glowing dog leaving through the light is an orange-and-white shiba-like puppy, not Usman (black dog, red kerchief).
The tambuli horn behind Indio's head reads as a pair of bull horns growing from his head.
The horn close-up merges into an animal-like face with a nostril and a human eye; reads as a face on the object.
A small red-and-white logo-like mark with glyphs in the top-left corner of the cave.
Small lines of pseudo-text on the letter and the framed notice on the wall.
Two Japanese-like glyphs printed on the rusty flashlight body.
Posters behind Lolo carry small Japanese-like text.
Pseudo-text shop sign ('2 SAIE') on the blue awning at left, plus small notices on the shutter.
Usman's white patch sits on his back and shoulder instead of his chest.
